summary: Cycle 14 observed: 25 of 27 hold; respawn-works now holds (back in 5.2 s, first moment alive 8 px from the catwalk checkpoint, standing 3 s on). Open: enemies-path (movedCount 2 by the probe's 'closer > 150' rule) and frame-cost (5.64x; noisy, the fight at the spot). The 30 px hatches let the AI cross the deck: a shotgun hunter walked 1924 px east across the old hatch at 5580 and closed 1270 px.

claims.text: respawn-works holds: first alive at x 13432 (8 px from the checkpoint at 13440), back on the catwalk at feet -330 within 5.2 s, still standing there 3 s on (x 13370). The move off the door fixed the point-blank respawn.

The narrow hatches changed the AI's paths as predicted: the shotgun hunter at (4100, -671), west of the old 140 px hatch at 5580, walked 1924 px to (6023, -731), 1270 px closer to the bait; the deck trooper west of the hatch walked to the player (5495 -> 5699, ending 105 px from the bait) instead of falling through. Ladders, co-op ladders, the tank and the boat still pass with them.

The probe's rule 'more than 150 px closer' misreads the residue ('the hunters walk towards a player ... at least three enemies move more than 150 px'): a hunter that starts 216 px away and walks up to the player (moved 207 px, ended 105 px off) can only be 110 px closer. The rule should count a hunter that closed 150 px OR came to the player (moved more than 150 px and ended within 200 px of it); falls, blasts and boat crews stay excluded. This refinement is being made after seeing cycle 14's data, under which it would give 3 (reached: the deck trooper; closed: the marksman 185, the shotgun hunter 1270) — so it is not credited from that data: it counts only if the re-run in the next cycle, with the new probe, shows it.

frame-cost: baseline 133; start 217, tower span 517, deck 750 (665 draws), road 417, the player held at every spot: 5.64x. The start spot fell from 517 to 217 between cycles (fewer awake soldiers near the dock this run), the deck rose from 617 to 750: the spots' cost moves with the fight, run to run.

Next: install the pathing probe with the refined rule (each hunter's reason recorded: closed / reached); run the in-loop frame matrix at the deck (baseline session, then the player held at (8300, -620), camera (8400, -700), three windows per step).

unknowns: Why the flame heavy walks east each run (1017-1475 px), away from the bait.
